Exact content:

```sql
-- =============================================================================
-- Migration : 20260506110000_payments_l2_country_and_uniques.sql
-- Sprint    : 15 — Connect Onboarding (Sage BLOCK fix)
-- Owner     : Dato (Principal Database Architect)
-- Spec      : Sage S15 audit verdict — CRIT-2 + HIGH-3
--
-- Purpose   :
--   1. Add `studios.country` column (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Stripe Connect Express
--      accounts are immutable on country — must be set correctly at onboarding.
--      Default 'US' on existing rows; new onboarding flows surface a country picker.
--   2. Add UNIQUE partial indexes on `stripe_connected_accounts`:
--      - One studio account per studio
--      - One artist account per artist
--      Prevents duplicate Connect accounts on race conditions.
--
-- Tables altered: studios (add country)
-- Indexes added: 2 partial UNIQUE on stripe_connected_accounts
--
-- DOWN:
--   DROP INDEX IF EXISTS uniq_stripe_connected_accounts_artist_type_artist;
--   DROP INDEX IF EXISTS uniq_stripe_connected_accounts_studio_type_studio;
--   ALTER TABLE studios DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS country;
-- =============================================================================

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 1 — studios.country column
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ALTER TABLE studios
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS country text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'US';

-- Add CHECK constraint separately so re-runs don't error if already present.
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conname = 'studios_country_iso2_check'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE studios
      ADD CONSTRAINT studios_country_iso2_check
      CHECK (country = upper(country) AND length(country) = 2);
  END IF;
END $$;

COMMENT ON COLUMN studios.country IS
  'ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Used to seed Stripe Connect Express account country (immutable on Stripe). Default ''US'' on existing rows; new studios should set explicitly during onboarding.';

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SECTION 2 — UNIQUE partial indexes on stripe_connected_accounts
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- One studio account per studio
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uniq_stripe_connected_accounts_studio_type_studio
  ON stripe_connected_accounts (studio_id)
  WHERE type = 'studio';

-- One artist account per artist
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uniq_stripe_connected_accounts_artist_type_artist
  ON stripe_connected_accounts (artist_id)
  WHERE type = 'artist' AND artist_id IS NOT NULL;
```
